summary: Mint Incorporation Limited furnished a Form 6-K reporting that its majority-owned subsidiary Rice Robotics (Hong Kong) Limited signed a non-exclusive, non-binding Framework Cooperation Agreement with Vengine Limited on September 10, 2026. The framework covers product development, manufacturing, and distribution support, with Vengine possibly introducing manufacturers and channel partners; no minimum purchase, volume, revenue, or payment obligations exist. No statement of work has been executed, and specific terms, deliverables, and timelines remain subject to future agreements. The 6-K is incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 registration statement. No special-situation or deal terms apply.
